name: Form Storage Tank (Web)
implementation_notes: The Storage Tank Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormStorageTank.php, exactly mirroring FormEffluentPlant's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 17 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Storage Tank has no computed detail-grid fields. 1 of them (Steam Heating Valve Status) renders as a <select> dropdown with an empty '-- Pilih --' option (Closed/Open 1/4/Open 1/2)

IMPORTANT -- enum empty-string-vs-null: the Steam Heating Valve Status dropdown submits '' when left unselected; StorageTankRecordService::normalizeDetails() (shared with screen-096) coerces this to null before validation/persistence, avoiding a SQLite CHECK constraint violation -- verified by a dedicated unit test and a Feature/Api test (Kernel Dispatch/Effluent Plant previously hit this same failure mode; this station's pre-existing crash-survived code already had the fix in place, confirmed correct rather than needing to be added)
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind

Route /data/storage-tank/create registered BEFORE /data/storage-tank/{id} (screen-106) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id} -- verified against the pre-existing (crash-survived) routes/web.php, already correct
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormEffluentPlant's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveStorageTankStationException (mirrors NoActiveEffluentPlantStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=storage-tank

deferred_items.description: The mobile 'Sinkronisasi' button does not yet call POST/PATCH /api/storage-tank-records for locally-entered records
deferred_items.reason: Out of this 6-screen task's explicit scope (see screen-096's implement artifact for the full rationale) -- the dual-guarded route already supports this when a future syncService.ts addition wires it up.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/FormStorageTankTest.php) was not authored/found for this screen in this task -- integration (Feature/Api) and component (Feature/Livewire) coverage is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's create/edit flow in a live dev server.
